summary: P54 stopped fail-closed during phase P54-03 after completing the reusable Phase/Package Scope Declaration v1 contract and a bounded TikTok Explore/Deep Audit. Five unauthenticated official-public requests across both authorized topics used zero quota and retained zero stable video identities; no challenge was confirmed and no browser/session/login/credential/bypass path was used. Adapter integration exposed a protected foundation blocker: adding a second Adapter Registry v1 row changes the full-document fingerprint pinned by immutable YouTube manifest KU2D-RM-000001-V001. Exact composition fails before the row is composed, while two-source composition fails the immutable fingerprint. Correcting that requires a historical-manifest migration or protected registry/runtime versioning outside P54 authority. The attempted adapter/registry changes were reverted, all seven invariant blobs remain identical to integration baseline ecd8614c6be78b662d637b1f2caa954fdb1b7dca, the exact feature head e9a927bcb11a497248b4b43536f6ff2cc8e89916 passed the complete 56/56 deterministic corpus, and no PR or merge was created.
